name: Chawanmushi (Savory Japanese Steamed Egg Custard)
whyItWorks: Silky dashi-infused steamed egg custard requires zero chewing and soothes an angry stomach immediately.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk eggs gently with warm dashi or chicken broth (1:3 ratio), strain through a sieve, and steam covered on low heat for 10-12 minutes.
